company.name: ELLIS
aliases: European Laboratory for Learning and Intelligent Systems

profile_text.body:
ELLIS, also known as the European Laboratory for Learning and Intelligent Systems, is a nonprofit organization headquartered in Europe. Its site describes it as a pan-European AI network of excellence that aims to secure lasting international leadership of AI made in Europe by connecting top researchers in the field and creating a multi-centric AI research laboratory. The organization says it unites AI researchers in Europe through Programs, Sites, and a PhD program, and that it fosters international collaboration across domains while investing in the next generation of AI talent.

The site describes the ELLIS PhD and Postdoc Program as pairing students with leading researchers across Europe in machine learning, AI and related fields, with international exchanges, joint supervision, and a research community. ELLIS Sites are described as hubs for AI research that can be made up of local AI research institutions and universities or newly created Institutes, and ELLIS Programs focus on theoretical foundations, algorithms, and applications such as health and climate, led by ELLIS Fellows and Scholars. The site also mentions the ELLIS Doctoral Symposium (EDS) 2026, organized by ELLIS Unit Lisbon, which it says brought together more than 100 PhD students, postdocs, researchers, and AI experts. No products, litigation, or MCP servers are recorded for the organization.
